shots.subject: Abstract network diagram with three disconnected nodes labeled 'Gate', 'UI', and 'File' showing conflicting status indicators

shots.subject: A central, glowing node labeled 'Authority' with multiple thin lines radiating out to smaller, dimmer nodes labeled 'Views'
